name: Cenarion Hold
summary: Cenarion Hold watches over the ancient dangers beneath Silithus. The Cenarion Circle keeps its druids in this desert stronghold, guarding what lies buried under the sands.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Dunes
sections.body: In southern Silithus, Cenarion Hold directs the Cenarion Circle's work. You reach it by winding past Un'Goro Crater. Raised after the War of the Shifting Sands, the fortress watches over dormant threats sealed beneath the desert. Silithus is harsh country, home to silithid and arid storms. The hold gives shelter, trade, and supplies to night elf and tauren druids who keep watch over those buried dangers.

sections.title: Neutral Ground
sections.body: Cenarion Hold stays neutral because guarding the world from ancient evils matters beyond mortal quarrels. Alliance and Horde travelers may enter, and quartermasters and wardens welcome them despite precarious supply lines. Flight routes link the hold with outposts in Feralas, Tanaris, and Un'Goro Crater. It is the desert's only staging ground for adventurers investigating the unrest there.

faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle governs and garrisons Cenarion Hold. Malfurion Stormrage founded the druidic order, and the neutral stronghold welcomes members of both the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.q: Why was the fortress built out here in the desert?
aliases: why is cenarion hold in silithus
faq.answer: The fortress was built after the War of the Shifting Sands to watch over the ancient evil sealed deep beneath Silithus and suppress the silithid resurgence in the region.

faq.q: How do you travel to Cenarion Hold?
aliases: how to get to cenarion hold
faq.answer: You can walk the steep mountain path northwest out of Un'Goro Crater. Flight routes link the hold to Gadgetzan, Un'Goro, and Feralas.

faq.q: Can members of both factions use services here?
faq.answer: Yes. Merchants and flight handlers at Cenarion Hold serve any adventurer willing to brave the desert, whatever their allegiance.

angles.text: As a druid, you find one of the largest druidic enclaves outside Moonglade at Cenarion Hold. It reflects the Circle's pledge to preserve natural balance against cosmic horrors.
As a night elf, you can see Cenarion Hold as a tribute to the ancient sacrifices made during the War of the Shifting Sands millennia ago.
